svg.title: Project 2 of 2: Pricing-Engine. A new price for every product of Lumo, the shop from Data-Generator, from elasticity estimated on price history and discounts, five competitors' prices and margin rules. Each price has a one-sentence reason, and the true elasticity checks the result. Methods: price elasticity, empirical Bayes, price index, margin rules, profit scenarios. Stack: Python, pandas, DuckDB, SciPy, Dash, Plotly. Animated preview: its web app (Dash) at work. The cursor drags the competitor limit from +5% to +10% and the largest price step from 10% to 15%, and the yearly gross profit grows from 8.09M to 8.40M PLN. Link below the card: View project.
